ExampleDesign.DisplayName: Versal Embedded Common Platform - No PL
ExampleDesign.Description:
The Versal Embedded Common Platform - No PL provides a minimal, Linux‑bootable starting point for Versal designs.
It includes only the PS, NoC, and DDR configuration required to boot Linux, with no default programmable logic (PL). This makes it a stable and reusable hardware baseline across Vivado, Vitis, and Embedded Linux flows.
Users can build their own applications by adding PL designs later, either directly in Vivado or as secondary pl.pdi images.
This approach ensures:
* A consistent hardware foundation across tools and examples
* Easier reuse and validation
* Clean separation between boot infrastructure and application logic
